_comment: Options of the micro-time histogram, drawn by emtk's view_form against HistogramFields in gui/app.py (attrs are its fields, button actions the app's methods, `enabled(name)` its hook). The detector definition itself is the shared channel-definition editor (its own dock tab).

buttons.label: ▶  Compute
buttons.description: Read the selected photons and burst gates in a background worker.

buttons.label: 💾  Save
buttons.description: Write the current shifted cumulative VV/VH decay to Output.

buttons.label: Transfer to ChiSurf
buttons.description: Save and add a TCSPC dataset with the current G-factor, time step and polarization.

sections.label: Autosave after compute
sections.description: Write the cumulative decay to Output once the computation succeeds.

sections.label: Detector
sections.description: Detector of the setup whose interleaved routing channels (parallel, perpendicular, parallel, ...) and G-factor are used.

sections.label: Parallel
sections.description: Comma-separated routing channels of the parallel (VV) stream; choosing a detector fills them.

sections.label: Perpendicular
sections.description: Comma-separated routing channels of the perpendicular (VH) stream; empty when polarization resolution is off.

sections.label: Polarization resolved
sections.description: Split the detector channels into alternating VV/VH routes; unchecked gives one unpolarized stream.

sections.label: Excitation window
sections.description: Apply this inclusive excitation micro-time gate, or include all windows.

sections.label: TTTR format
sections.description: Container reader override; Auto uses the file header (headerless SPC data needs its subtype).

sections.label: Binning
sections.description: Group this many adjacent micro-time bins.

sections.label: Inter-photon filter
sections.description: Keep only photons whose next selected photon follows within the gap below: the photons of bursts. With Invert, keep the isolated photons between them instead: a background decay from the same measurement.

sections.label: Max gap [ticks]
sections.description: Largest gap to the next selected photon, in macro-time ticks (200000 ticks is 2.7 ms at a 13.5 ns clock).

sections.label: Invert (isolated photons)
sections.description: Keep the photons whose next selected photon is at least the gap away: the background between bursts.

sections.label: dt [ns]
sections.description: Nanoseconds per binned TAC channel; reading derives it from the header. Typing a value keeps it (Manual time step).

sections.label: Manual time step
sections.description: Keep the entered time step instead of the file header's resolution.

sections.label: G-Factor
sections.description: Weights VH by 2G in the combined VV + 2G VH trace.

sections.label: VV shift (channels)
sections.description: Pad or clip the VV histogram by this many bins; photon times are not wrapped.

sections.label: VH shift (channels)
sections.description: Pad or clip the VH histogram by this many bins; photon times are not wrapped.

sections.label: Output
sections.description: Single-column export: VV bins followed by VH bins, compatible with read_vv_vh.

sections.label: Polarization
sections.description: TCSPC reader polarization mode used when the saved decay is transferred.
